assurance: no attested selected-sandbox execution; OS isolation and model identity are not asserted

findings.disposition: NVA-G05 now distinguishes one physical/global resource from an independent-branch merge collision.
Semantic receipts exclude themselves; increment evidence uses tested candidate plus E1 readback and gate-only E2 without an enclosing-commit self-reference.
The Spec now names transitions.ndjson and the actual pipeline.backlog-transaction.v1 compatibility schema.
Transition v1 remains frozen; additive transition v2 defines mixed-ledger chaining and in-progress evidence amendment.
Nova A is in-memory/immutable-evidence only; B1-I/B2-I are blocked behind a separate executor/state/credential ADR.
Final readback occurs while preimages remain; canonical idempotency receipt, committed phase, lock owner and stale recovery are explicit.
Every exported writer is routed, retired or projection-only, with negative authority tests required.
All registry records now have required root keys, nested closed types, bounds, nullability, discriminators and stable error classes.
Only verified work enters completed; dependent terminal projection, unrelated continuation and queue revision are exact.
Positive selected-child evidence, N+1 same-envelope pool proof, pause/restart and monotonic orphan behavior are non-vacuous.
A1/A7/B3-R/B5/B6 evidence, schema, fixture, documentation and bounded runtime templates are enumerated; deferred adapters stay blocked.
Warm-up, repetitions, clock, scoring thresholds, stop conditions and rollback are fixed as nova-efficiency-v1.
The readiness package binds the final corrected Spec/acceptance and moves lifecycle to awaiting-approval without implementation authority.
